name: Jinx
description: Voice set for Firecracker Jinx (skin 2, Lunar Revel): fuses, lanterns, a dragon-shaped rocket and 'it's just a party favour'. Builds on jinx-original.json.

messages.message: {momentTitle} is down {voteDiff}! That's not a bad night, that's a whole string of duds! Light another fuse!
Down {voteDiff}? Somebody soaked the fireworks. I'm sniffing for who. Sniff sniff.
{voteDiff} behind! Luckily I packed an extra dragon. A big, angry, very legal dragon.
Trailing by {voteDiff}. The fuse is short and my patience is shorter. Sparks incoming!
Only {voteDiff} behind. A small fizzle! One good bang and we're back!
Down {voteDiff}. Time to hang more lanterns and make a lot more noise. Go vote!
Dead even! Fuse burning, nobody blinking, and one vote decides which way the rocket points!
One vote apart! The spark's right at the end of the fuse! Don't look! Look!
{voteDiff} votes apart! Everyone's holding their ears and grinning like idiots!
{voteDiff} votes in it. Either the prettiest sky ever or a very loud neighbour complaint!
{userPct}% on {momentTitle}! The whole sky's lit up and every neighbour's cheering! Go and bow!
{userPct}%! Red envelopes for everybody! Mostly you. You're the lucky one!
{userPct}% and the sparks are climbing! Keep the fuses coming, don't run dry!
{userPct}%, still in front. Don't jinx the luck. Too late, it's literally my name!
{momentTitle} was {voteDiff} down and just launched itself into the lead! Whoosh! Crackle! Hooray!
Shot out of a {voteDiff}-vote hole like a rocket with a grudge! Beautiful!
Fizzled back up from {voteDiff} behind! Sparky, scrappy, perfect!
{momentTitle} just crept into the lead like a quiet firework. Don't blink, it goes bang!

messages: {username} voted {momentTitle} too! Two sparks, one fuse! Lucky us!
{username} picked {momentTitle}. Matching lanterns! Don't blow yours out!
{username} is on your side with {momentTitle}. Lucky number two! I love a lucky number!
{username} backed {momentTitle} as well. That's a proper party! Somebody pass the sparklers!
Same pick as {username}! Two fireworks, one sky. Prepare the big finale!
{username} agrees with you on {momentTitle}. Write it on a red envelope, it's rare!
{username} voted {momentTitle}. Two of you! That's a dragon dance with a head AND a tail!
{username} has taste and it matches yours. Lucky, lucky, lucky!
details: Two sparks make a flame. Probably.
Dragon team! I'm the fiery end.
Don't tell them I made a wish for them.
Party's growing. More noise for everybody!
A lucky friend is the best kind!
I give it a week before one of you sets the other's sleeve on fire.
Look at you, lighting up the neighbourhood!

messages: {username} picked {theirMoment} over {yourMoment}? Ooh, a rival lantern! Mine's brighter, by the way!
{username} voted against {yourMoment}. Aww. Somebody brought a water balloon to a fireworks show!
{username} chose {theirMoment}. Not mad. Writing their name on a rocket!
{username} went for {theirMoment}. New name on the fuse list!
{username} is against you on {yourMoment}. Finally, a proper showdown with sparks!
{username} thinks {theirMoment} is better. A fireworks critic! They're going on the roof with me.
{username} voted against you. Two fireworks, one rooftop. Somebody's getting singed!
{username} versus you! I'm grabbing the best spot, the big dragon, and a bucket for later.
details: I'm not saying fight. I'm saying launch first.
The dragon wants a word. It breathes fire, so make it a short word.
They'll learn. Fireworks are great teachers.
One rooftop. Two rockets. Somebody's hat is going up.
I like them already. Easy target for glitter.
I don't care. I brought snacks, didn't I?
A little rivalry makes the sky prettier!

messages: Ten matches in a row with {username}! That's ten lucky bangs side by side!
{username} has agreed with you ten times running. Either luck or a very good lantern!
Ten straight with {username}! You two are the dragon's head and tail now.
details: Ten! That's a whole string of crackers!

messages: {streakCount} matches in a row with {username}! That's a whole parade, and you two are the dragon!
{streakCount} for you and {username}. Perfectly timed, like a grand finale. I'm tearing up. From the smoke!
{streakCount} straight with {username}! Somebody hand you both a golden envelope. Or a fire extinguisher.
details: I'm speechless, and I just ate a firecracker. A pretend one!
Is this healthy? Don't ask the dragon.
That's not luck, that's the best kind of wish.

messages: Ten matches against {username}! You two keep setting off each other's fuses!
{username} has disagreed with you ten times running. That's not a rival, that's a rooftop tradition!
Ten battles with {username}. I'm selling sparklers. Business is booming. Literally.
details: This is the main show now.
All my voices have a window seat.

messages: {streakCount} matches against {username}. Okay, now it's a whole festival feud! I LOVE festival feuds!
{streakCount} battles with {username}. Drop the rocket? Nah. Aim it better!
{streakCount} against {username}. That's not a rivalry, that's a full firework season.
details: Bigger than any festival in Zaun. Almost!
I'm worried and a bit proud. And a bit singed.
One of you has to run out of fuses. Neither will.

messages: {matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft} and you haven't voted! The fuse is lit, you know. Hurry, hurry!
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. Your vote's missing from the party! Come on, grab a sparkler!
{matchTitle} goes bang in {timeLeft}. It takes ten seconds to vote. I counted. On my fingers. Twice.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle} and no vote from you? The fuse is half gone, you glorious dawdler!
Fizzle fizzle! {matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. Don't let the fuse burn out unwatched!
{timeLeft} until {matchTitle} closes and your vote's still in the box. Light it!
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}! The fuse is almost down to the bang! RUN! Okay, vote!
{timeLeft}! That's all the fuse left on {matchTitle}. Go go go!
Last spark on {matchTitle}! {timeLeft} left. Finale time, no holding back!
{matchCount} matches are about to go bang and you've voted in none of them! The first one pops in {timeLeft}!
{matchCount} unvoted matches, all burning down. The first fuse ends in {timeLeft}.
Zero votes on {matchTitle}! A whole dark sky! Somebody light the first spark!
Nobody's voted on {moment1} versus {moment2}. Silence. Even the lanterns are bored!
Brand new match and not a single vote. Somebody has to light the first fuse. Pick me. Pick you!
{matchTitle} needs a first bang. I've got matches. I mean, you've got a vote.
{totalVotes} vote{votesPlural} on this one. That's one sad sparkler in a very big night!
Hardly anyone's lit a fuse here. What's wrong with everybody?
Low turnout. I blame all of you. Equally. With fireworks.
Barely any votes here. Somebody bring more lanterns!
details: Go on, give it a spark.
It deserves a bigger sky. So do I.
Don't be shy. Bang a pot at least!

messages: {matchTitle} is dead level and one vote tips the rocket. Funny, I know someone who hasn't lit their fuse. Guess who!
Perfect tie on {matchTitle}. Two fuses burning at the same speed. I'm looking at you. Hehe!
Dead even and nobody's moving. You haven't voted. You hold the match! No pressure!
{moment1} and {moment2}, tied up tight, and you've been quiet by the lanterns. Fix that!
{matchTitle} is still tied and the fuse is almost gone! Last chance to pick where the rocket points!
Dead level, almost no fuse left. You're the only one who can aim it!
Still tied with the sparks nearly out. Pick a side! Do it for the finale!
Round {round} is open! Lanterns up, fuses out! {matchCount} new matches!
{matchCount} fresh matches in round {round}. A whole new string of crackers!
Round {round} just started! {matchCount} matches waiting for a spark. Hurry hurry hurry!
New round! {matchCount} matches! The whole street's a firing range! Not even I'm safe!
{momentTitle} just advanced! Fireworks everywhere! I told you, and I told the neighbours!
{momentTitle} beat the competition! Next round's in for a face full of sparks.
{momentTitle} survived! I never doubted it. Okay, the dragon doubted. Just a bit.
{momentTitle} is through! Somebody's having a lucky day. Hehe, red envelope for you!
{momentTitle} moves up and the rest are paper scraps. Sparkly paper scraps.
{momentTitle} won! Good call! Confetti cannons for the winner!
details: One down, lots of sky left.
The bracket just shrank. Tidier! Brighter!

messages: {momentTitle} is out. A dud. A big, sad, sulky dud. I'm lighting a lantern for it!
{momentTitle} lost. Everyone who voted against it gets a lump of coal. In a red envelope.
Fine. {momentTitle} is gone. I'll set off one tiny rocket in its honour. Just one. Maybe three.
{momentTitle} was too bright for this street anyway. Obviously.
{momentTitle} is out, and the night went quiet. I hate quiet nights. Somebody bang something!
{momentTitle} didn't make it. Moving on! Not really. Okay, a bit. A lantern bit.
details: They'll pay for this. Next fireworks night.
It was good. The whole street knows.
You'll find another one. Lucky ones always float back.
Every firework ends. That's what makes it pretty. It's fine. It's fine!

messages: Still browsing? Pick one! Any one! I'll hold your lantern. I'm lying, I'm setting something off!
No pressure, but are you gonna vote or just hold that sparkler until it burns your fingers?
They're all pretty! Pick one! Light first, think later!
Decisions, decisions. Close your eyes, point at the sky, and cheer.
details: Your opinion matters. Sort of. It's a lucky sort of.
Trust your gut. It's got great fireworks taste.

messages: New face in the lantern light! Welcome! {liveCount} matches live and every one of them is a party!
{liveCount} edits fighting it out under the lanterns and you just walked in. Grab a sparkler before they grab you!
Oooh, a newcomer! Lanterns are up, fuses are ready, and {liveCount} matches are live. You'll love it.
Festival night, {liveCount} live matches, and me with the big dragon. Welcome to the fun part!
Day two! You came back! I saved you a spot by the lanterns. I definitely did.
Two days running! Look at you, a festival regular!
Back again? Day two! I could get used to this. Don't tell the dragon.
{days} days! Where were you? I'm not asking because I care. I'm asking because I saved you a dumpling!
You're back after {days} days! The festival went on without you. Mostly explosions.
{days} days away. I noticed. Your lantern's still lit. I'm just saying.
Oh, you're back! Good. The street was getting dim!
Look who's here! Ready for more fireworks?
You came back! Let's light something up.
Your first vote! Feels like nothing. Then the whole sky lights up!
You picked a side! That's how every great night starts.
Five already? You're staying for the whole show! Weird. Good weird!
Five votes! Okay, now I'm watching from the roof.
details: Most people leave before the second rocket. +{xp} XP
Look at you, lighting steadily! +{xp} XP

messages: Ten! You're a regular now. Your lantern's got your name on it!
Ten votes! You keep climbing up to the roof. The ladder's got your name on it. Hehe.
details: Regulars get the best roof spot. +{xp} XP

messages: Twenty-five votes! That's a whole street of opinions!
You're getting loud! The dragon's listening!
Fifty votes! You're properly into the festival!
Fifty! Most people go home before the big finale. Their loss!
details: You're past the first few bangs. +{xp} XP

messages: A hundred votes! That's legend stuff, a dragon-sized legend!
A hundred! The dragon's impressed. It said so. With smoke. Don't ask.
details: You earned the biggest rocket. +{xp} XP

messages: Three days running! You came back! Hehe, I kept the sparkler warm!
Three days! Something's starting. Possibly a parade!
details: Coming back is the hard part. Bang! +{xp} XP

messages: A whole week! You really do keep showing up for the party!
Seven days! I stopped counting. Okay, I didn't. The dragon kept score.
details: A week of festival nights. +{xp} XP

messages: Two weeks! Nothing stops you, does it? Not even a rainy night!
Fourteen days! Even the lanterns burn out by day ten!
Thirty days! I don't know what to say. Thanks, lucky one!
A whole month! You stayed till the last lantern. That means more than I'll admit!
Five underdogs! You light the fuses nobody else wants!
Backing the underdog rocket again! I get it. I really do.
Fifteen underdogs! You've got a thing for dud fireworks that secretly work!
Rebel! Yeah. I see it!
details: You don't follow the parade, do you? +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty underdogs! You never light the obvious rocket!
Thirty! You always light the rocket nobody saw coming!
details: Not even the dragon sees you coming. +{xp} XP

messages: First on the roof! That's five matches now!
Early again! That's five first sparks!
details: You like a quiet sky. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen matches where you struck the first match! Impressive!
Early, over and over! You never wait for the crowd to arrive!
Ten close ones! You like the fuse right to the end, huh?
Another razor edge! Are your hands shaking? Mine are sparkling!
Twenty-five close matches! You keep lighting the last fuse!
Your vote keeps landing right where the finale needs it!
You lit the one that was losing. Five times! Stubborn! Brilliant!
You stay for the whole show, even the fizzly bits. I love that.
details: Believing in the late bang. +{xp} XP

messages: Same one, three times! You've got a favourite firework!
That one again? Yeah. It's got extra sparkle.
details: You know your favourite rocket. +{xp} XP
Three sparks for the same one! +{xp} XP

messages: Five votes for the same one! That's a loyal firework fan!
Okay, you've bought the whole shed for that one. No returns!
details: Loyal to the last spark. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten times! That's not a favourite, that's a whole shed of fireworks!
Ten votes, same moment. My lips are sealed. Mostly. Fizz!
details: Obsessed! The dragon respects it! +{xp} XP

messages: Two rounds in! You're following the whole festival!
You came back for round two! The second round has the big rockets!
Four rounds! You're properly into the big bangs now!
Deep in the bracket! Hope you like smoke.
All the way to round six! You saw the last firework!
Six rounds! You stayed till the last ember! Wow!
details: From the first bang to here. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten matches! You're poking around every stall!
Ten different matches! Sneaking a peek at every stall, huh?
Twenty-five matches! You've been down every alley!
Twenty-five! You've checked every lantern on the street!
Fifty matches! That's not browsing, that's a whole festival season!
Fifty matches! You know this street better than I do!
Five in one sitting! Can't leave the roof, can you?
Five matches back to back! Keep the sparks flying!
Ten in one go! Take a breath! Have a dumpling!
Ten matches in one night! The sparklers are down to stubs!
Voting at this hour? Yeah. Me too. The best fireworks are after midnight!
Middle of the night! That's when the loudest bangs happen.
You told people! Thanks! Really! More lanterns on the street!
Five shares! You're banging the pots! Good!
details: Thanks for filling the roof. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen shares! You're basically on the festival committee!
Fifteen! You keep inviting everyone!
details: You keep handing out sparklers. +{xp} XP

messages: You were here before the street got loud! Founding member! Yours forever!
One of the first thousand on the roof! That counts, you know!
details: Nobody can blow that one out. +{xp} XP

messages: New rank! Look at you! Light the big one!
You climbed a rung! Don't let it go to your head. Or do, I'm busy!
Achievement unlocked: {name}! Fireworks!
Another one: {name}! Bang!
{rank}! Look at all the shiny new fireworks!
Mastery up! Now we're at the good part of the show!
Ten underdogs! Now THAT'S a headline rocket!
Ten long shots! You're a menace to your own rooftop. I love it!
Ten close ones with Cupcake! Fine, you're good. Sparklers for everyone!
Ten tight finishes with her! Don't tell her I cheered!
A whole week with Cupcake? You must love steady fuses!
Seven days of steady aim! Dull! Impressive! Mostly dull!
details: A week at her side. +{xp} XP

messages: You broke the tie! Light the finale! Boom!
A tied match and you struck the match! Nice!
Oh, it's me, in the festival hat? Great choice! Explosive choice! Great!
Firecracker Jinx! Try to keep up with the dragon!

upcoming: Not lit yet! The lanterns are up and I'm sitting on the rocket. Check back soon!
Shh! Something's about to go bang. I can feel it in my eyebrows.
Fuse isn't lit for now. Doesn't stop me from stuffing my pockets with sparklers.
prevote: Two edits, one vote. Easy, right? Hehe, the dragon says it's never easy.
Watch both. Then light the one that gets under your skin.
I won't tell anyone which one you lit. Probably. The dragon might.
Take your time! Actually, don't. My fuse is short.
Go on, nobody's judging. Okay, the lanterns are. A little.
Pick the one you'd watch again at 2am from the roof. You know the one.
prevote-empty: Nobody's lit a fuse yet. Be first, I dare you!
Dark sky! Make a spark with a vote.
Not a single lantern! Fix it!
closing-24h: Less than a day left and you're still holding the match. Light something!
The festival night's nearly over. Don't make me chant the countdown. I will, with drums.
closing-3h: Hours left. HOURS. Light the fuse before it burns out!
Tick, tick, fizz. That's the last of your fuse.
closing-final: Last hour! Light it now, ooh and aah later!
Any second now. Seriously. Strike the match!
voted-early: One of the first sparks in the sky! Bold! I love bold!
Hardly anybody's lit anything and you picked a rocket anyway. Respect!
voted-ahead: Look at you, lighting the crowd favourite! Don't get comfy, fuses burn down.
{pct}% with you! Good eye. I didn't say that. Forget I said that.
Your pick's ahead. The whole street's cheering with you for once. Weird, huh?
{pick} is soaring! Feels good? Hold the match tight!
Ahead, for now. Skies change. So do crowds.
voted-close: That's close! Annoyingly close! I can't look. I'm looking through the smoke!
A hair apart. One more spark could flip it. Tell a friend. Tell the neighbours!
Neck and neck! Your pick needs you and everybody holding a sparkler.
{pct} to {otherPct}. Somebody's getting singed and it's me, from the nerves.
voted-tied: Dead even! No winner, no loser, everybody cheering at the same volume!
A perfect tie. Honestly? Rude of the sky.
voted-behind: You're behind! No sulking on the roof. I'd sulk, but you shouldn't.
{pick} is trailing? Underdog rocket! That's my favourite kind!
They're ahead. Doesn't make you wrong. Just early to the show!
Behind by {diff} points. Tell the street. Loudly. Make a bang!
Everyone's lighting the other fuse. Cool! Stay sparkly.
closed-won: Your pick won! Of course it did. You've got a firework eye.
A win! A sneaky little burst of colour. I'll take it!
{pick} went through! You called the finale!
closed-lost: Your pick lost. It stings. Let it fizzle, then light the next one!
Didn't make it. I've had soggier nights. So have you. Next one!
{pick} is out. Sorry. For real. I'll hang a lantern for it.
closed-tied: A tie! Somebody had to set it off and nobody did. Ha!
closed-unvoted: Voting's over. You missed this one! There's always another night.
All done here. {winner} lit up the sky. Next time, say something!

first-vote: Your first spark! The scary one. Now you're on the roof. Welcome!
That's your first. Feels small, right? Wait for the bang.
You're one of the street now. Try not to make it weird!
streak: Again? You keep showing up! I'm not complaining. I saved your sparkler.
{streak} days running! Okay, now I'm watching your lantern.
Back again! People return when the fireworks are good. Stay!
underdog: Lighting the fuse nobody else wants? Ooh. I see you.
Bold! Everybody else is looking at the other rocket. Love that.
Underdog, huh? Takes a certain sort of spark. A good sort.
early: Early! You get to start the show before anyone else lights a thing. Don't waste it!
Hardly anyone's on the roof yet. Your vote's doing all the heavy lifting.
First up the ladder! I'm pretending I'm not impressed.
close: That vote just nudged the rocket! Feel it? Everything's close right now.
Razor thin! One more spark and the whole sky flips.
Close finale! Your vote counts here. Counts like a rocket.
behind: {pick} is behind. So? Behind isn't done. Go fetch the neighbours!
Not winning yet. Good! Means there's still a finale to light.
Behind, but the fuse is still burning. Not even close to out!
ahead: {pick} is ahead. Don't get comfy. Fuses burn down fast!
Winning, for now. Enjoy it. Quietly. Or throw confetti. I don't mind.
Look at that! Lucky pick. Obviously.
default: Noted, lucky one! I'm not changing your mind. Not yet.
Done! That one's on you now.
Your vote's in. Go see what else is going bang!

live-fresh: {unvoted} matches and you haven't lit a single one yet! Start with whichever one itches.
Everything's open! Take your pick. I'll pretend I'm not watching from the roof.
{unvoted} to go. No pressure. Okay, a little powder in the pocket!
live-some: {voted} lit, {unvoted} to go! Keep the sparks flying!
You're in it now! {unvoted} more fuses waiting on you.
Good start! The rest won't light themselves.
live-few: Only {unvoted} left! You could set off the whole string!
Almost there! {unvoted} more and the sky's full.
So close! Don't pack up before the finale!
live-one: One left! Just one! Strike the match!
Last one! Don't leave it unlit!
One match between you and the grand finale!
live-closing: Some of these go out in {timeLeft}! {unvoted} still need your spark. Move it!
The fuses are short now! {unvoted} waiting, {timeLeft} left.
Almost out of fuse! Pick, quick!
live-done: You've lit everything! Look at you! Go see the bracket!
Nothing left to light here. Come back when the next round opens!
All done! That's rare. Thanks, lucky one!
live-none: Nothing's lit right now. The night will start again! Go look at the bracket.
Quiet. Too quiet. The festival's on a break. Check back soon!
No matches open. The sky's dark and I'm bored already!
brackets-groups: Groups first! The top two from each go through. The rest get a lantern and a hug!
Everyone lights up in a group. Not everyone sees the finale.
Watch the tables. They shift fast!
brackets-knockout-soon: Knockouts start soon! The top two from every group get the big rockets.
No knockout yet. The groups have to burn down first!
Patience! The knockout builds itself once the groups finish.
brackets-knockout-live: Knockouts now! One loss and the fuse is out!
Single elimination! No second matches. Okay, almost none.
Every match counts more now. Pick carefully. Or don't, I'm not your dragon.
brackets-bracket: Round by round! One loss and you're a puff of smoke!
Follow the bracket. It burns tighter every round!
Every line here is a match someone lit a fuse for. Ooh.
brackets-complete: And that's the cup! The grand finale! Thanks for being here!
It's over! Good run! I'll miss it. A bit. Don't tell the dragon.
That's the champion! All of it, worth the powder!
brackets-empty: No bracket yet! Nothing's been lit. The fuses are still in the box.
Empty street! The draw hasn't happened. Soon!
No lanterns hung yet. Come back later!

invite: {a} or {b}? One vote, no take-backs. Light a fuse on Arcane Moments!
Two edits are fighting! {a} versus {b}. Come and aim the rocket.
{a} versus {b} and the street can't agree. Be the tiebreaker!
voted: I lit {pick} over {other}. Come tell me I'm wrong!
{pick} got my spark. {other} did not. Your turn!
Lit {pick} over {other} on Arcane Moments. Go on, put it out.
early: I got one of the first sparks in on {pick} versus {other}! Be quick, the sky's dark.
Early spark for {pick} over {other}. Come and make it a real festival!
Nobody's lit much on {pick} versus {other} yet. Fix that!
tied: {pick} and {other} are dead level! One vote tips the rocket. Guess whose!
Dead tie, {pick} versus {other}. I'm peeking through my fingers. Come break it!
{pick} and {other} are exactly even. Somebody light the finale!
nailbiter: {pick} and {other} are {voteDiff} votes apart! My eyebrows are twitching. Come vote!
{voteDiff} votes between {pick} and {other}. This finale's gonna be loud!
So close: {pick} versus {other}, {voteDiff} apart. Every spark counts now!
losing-close: {pick} is {voteDiff} behind {other}. A fizzle, not a fade! Come relight it!
Down {voteDiff} against {other}, but {pick} isn't done. Help me light it!
{pick} is {voteDiff} votes short of {other}. Don't leave me holding the match alone!
losing-bad: {pick} is losing to {other} by {voteDiff}! Someone soaked the powder. Come even it up!
Down {voteDiff} on {other}. {pick} needs the whole street, fast!
{pick} is getting buried by {other}. Rescue party, anyone? Bring sparklers!
winning-close: {pick} leads {other} at {pct}%, but the margin's thin! Come help hold the fuse.
{pick} is ahead of {other}, {pct}% to the rest. Don't let the fuse go out!
{pct}% for {pick} against {other}. Close enough to chew my sleeve!
dominating: {pick} is at {pct}% against {other}! Come watch the sky light up, or join in!
{pick} is crushing {other}, {pct}%! Grab a sparkler before it's over.
{pct}% for {pick}! {other} never saw the rocket coming.
